- Orientation upright. A damaged parchment fragment, roughly 29 x 19 cm on the scale; top and bottom margins partly lost, lower right corner torn away diagonally, large losses/abrasion (whitish patches, apparently surface loss or paper repair) over the upper left and upper middle.
- Three columns of text visible (left column badly abraded in its upper half; middle column damaged at top; right column the best preserved). The right edge shows another column's ghost/offset (green/blue letters showing through or offset) and a small stamp-like mark at right edge near middle.
- Content form (observation): short alphabetical entries, each beginning with an enlarged two-line initial alternating red and blue; in the middle and right columns the headwords all begin with F (Fa-), e.g. "Falsitas", "Fames", "Fantasia", "Far", "Farrago". Interpretation (tentative): a Latin alphabetical glossary / word list with brief definitions.
- Marginal red letters to the left of some entries (source marks?): "hy", "sol", "Pap"?, "Ser"? (read below on tiles). Observation only.
- Script: small Gothic textualis (book hand), black-brown ink, heavy abbreviation, dots as punctuation, punctus elevatus/flex at entry ends.
- Rubrication: initials red/blue alternating; marginal red notes.

Plan: face A tiles are probably image-002..009 (002/003 tall = left column; 004-006 = middle column top/mid/bottom; 007-009 = right column top/mid/bottom). Face B overview image-010 with tiles 011-019; image-020 and image-027 overviews with tiles 021-026 and 028-033. To be checked as I go.

Conventions used: (..) = proposed expansion; [..] = lost/unread letters; "?" after a reading = uncertain; "u°" = u with a superscript o-like sign (frequent; expansion left open, perhaps u(er)o); "(con)" for the reversed-c sign; "(et)" for the tironian note; "q(uia)?" for q + 2-shaped sign; "[I/s]la(m)" for a recurring word beginning with a tall long-s or I with a leftward hook (image-012/013 l.13, image-023 l.5, image-024 l.11, image-033 l.13), left unexpanded.
